# `^BB` – CODABLOCK Bar Code

[Overview](../README.md) · [Libraries](../libraries/README.md) · [Commands](README.md) · [Features](../features/README.md) · [Evidence legend](../METHODOLOGY.md) · [Compare images](../../benchmarks/accuracy/README.md)


Print a CODABLOCK two-dimensional stacked barcode (modes A, E, F) for encoding large amounts of data.

Reference parameters: **o, h, s, c, r, m**. These describe the reference grammar, not a promise that any library honors every parameter. [Zebra guide, page 90](../../zpl-zbi2-pg-en.pdf).
